title: Vietnamese Protest Mysterious Fish Kill

image.attribution: 保守 / Wikimedia Commons / Public Domain.

main_content:
Hundreds of people demonstrated in Vietnam on Sunday against a company they accuse of killing large numbers of fish along the country’s coast.

An official investigation has found no links between the fish kill and a plant along the coast. The factory belongs to a Taiwanese company, Formosa Plastics.

Protesters carried signs reading, “Formosa destroying the environment is a crime” Demonstrations are rare in Vietnam.

At first, the environmental disaster was thought to have resulted from industrial waste. Some Vietnamese and environmental activists believe it came from the huge steel plant.

Last week, Vietnamese officials said they failed to find evidence linking the fish kill to the factory.

The government also said that the fish kill could have resulted from chemicals released by humans.
